about: Draft trailer (animatic) for the AutoPipeline guide, 60 s at 96 bpm: every scene is a whole number of 2.5 s bars and the before/after reveal lands on bar 17 (40 s), where the Oro score (autopipeline-trailer.oro.txt) hits. Terminal text is pasted from real runs of AutoPipeline 0.1.5 on 21 October 2026 (package folder shortened to $AP_DIR). Storyboard and shot list: docs/autopipeline/guide-video.md. The VC3D shots are a diagram here until they are recorded.
